content:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: July ops snapshot — rollups & QBR prep

Team,

Attached is the July operational dashboard (PDF) and a short snapshot below. This thread is to: 1) capture immediate actions for stability/cost, and 2) align owners for the QBR slide we’ll present on Tue the 28th. Please reply with owners and short ETA for each item by EOD Mon (7/27).

High level numbers (week-over-week where relevant):
- Latency: p95 inference latency up ~12% month-over-month; p99 up ~18%. Spike centered around long-sequence generation on model-x.
- Cost: per-1M-token infra cost +8% vs June, driven by increased small-batch tail latency and repeat cache-misses.
- Uptime: 99.92% for the month — missed the 99.95% platform SLO due to a partial outage in us-west on 2026-07-10 (approx 34 minutes of elevated error rates).
- Usage: total tokens +24%, embeddings jobs +40% (single large customer), steady growth in background reranking.

Primary asks:
- Root cause summary for the us-west incident + short-term mitigation (owner & ETA).
- Concrete low-lift changes we can deploy this week to reduce p95 tail (batching/timeout/queue tweaks).
- Cost tactics: top 3 actions to pull unit cost down (quantization, batching, traffic routing).
- A single slide for QBR with current metric trends and our plan (I’ll consolidate).

Attachments: 2026-07-monthly-dashboard.pdf (dashboard), detailed CSVs to follow.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
VP Operations, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: July ops snapshot — rollups & QBR prep

Markus —

Quick notes and I attached two files: ops-latency-breakdown.csv and incident-timeline.txt.

Incident (us-west, 7/10) summary:
- Root cause: Combined effect of a misconfigured autoscale policy + a recent KV-cache invalidation we rolled out with model-x. Several inference workers returned cache misses at the same time, causing a wave of cold-starts and long-tail latency.
- Short-term mitigation taken: tightened autoscale thresholds and flipped a fallback to a lower-memory kernel for model-x (reduced p99 for that window).
- Medium term: we need a KV cache warm-restart procedure, and to add guarded slow-starts when a cache invalidation is detected. I recommend a maintenance window to run a controlled cache flush and pre-warm.

Immediate actions I can own:
1) Batching/queue tweak: reduce max_wait_ms from 8ms -> 4ms for model-x and prioritize small-token requests via separate queue. ETA: deploy canary by Fri 7/30; full rollout Mon 8/2.
2) Observability: add per-model tail-latency alarms + SLA dashboard for top 10 models. ETA: Wednesday 7/29.

A note on customers: that large embeddings spike is mostly Nimbus Health (their nightly jobs increased). Looping in Sarah from Nimbus for a brief sync — will ask for permission to move some of their non-urgent jobs to off-peak windows.

Attachments referenced: ops-latency-breakdown.csv (per-model distribution), incident-timeline.txt (event log).

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference

Adding cost perspective: I attached cost-snapshot.xlsx with per-model cost deltas. Top three levers:
1) Enable 4-bit quantization for model-x inference paths (test on dedicated pools first).
2) Encourage high-volume customers (notably Nimbus Health) to move non-peak jobs to off-peak windows — propose a tiered discount for scheduled windows.
3) Review cold-start billing by enabling more aggressive prefix caching for frequent routes.

I can own the quantization plan and the pricing toggle proposal for scheduled windows. ETA: quantization test plan by Tue 7/28; pricing proposal by Fri 7/31.

—Marissa

Head of Product, Cost & Ops, Redwood Inference

Sarah — thanks for being available to sync. If you’re open, can we schedule a 30-min call Wed (7/29) morning to walk through the proposed off-peak window?

I’ll attach the final slide after I pull all inputs.

Best,
Markus
